LatticePeriodic.statement: def LatticePeriodic {E : Type*} (f : Position → E) : Prop := ∀ (m : Fin 3 → ℤ) (x : Position), f (x + fun i ↦ (m i : ℝ)) = f x

SmoothSolution.statement: structure SmoothSolution (times : Set ℝ) (u₀ : Position → Velocity) (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) (p : ℝ → Position → ℝ) : Prop where initialSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u₀ initialPeriodic : LatticePeriodic u₀ initialDivergenceFree : ∀ x, spatialDivergence u₀ x = 0 velocitySmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Position ↦ u z.1 z.2) (times ×ˢ Set.univ) pressureSmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Position ↦ p z.1 z.2) (times ×ˢ Set.univ) velocityPeriodic : ∀ t ∈ times, LatticePeriodic (u t) pressurePeriodic : ∀ t ∈ times, LatticePeriodic (p t) momentum : ∀ t ∈ times, ∀ x, derivWithin (fun s ↦ u s x) times t + fderiv ℝ (u t) x ((u t x).ofLp) = spatialLaplacian (u t) x - pressureGradient (p t) x incompressible : ∀ t ∈ times, ∀ x, spatialDivergence (u t) x = 0 initial : u 0 = u₀

galileanPressure.basis: Independent back-translation, then Tao v5 equation (1), notation, and Section 2 mean-zero reduction, with explicit moving-frame and norm calculations. See runs/review-2026-11-23-mean-zero.md.
galileanPressure.statement: def galileanPressure (c : Velocity) (p : ℝ → Position → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : Position) : ℝ := p t (x + t • c.ofLp)

galileanVelocity.basis: Independent back-translation, then Tao v5 equation (1), notation, and Section 2 mean-zero reduction, with explicit moving-frame and norm calculations. See runs/review-2026-11-23-mean-zero.md.
galileanVelocity.statement: def galileanVelocity (c : Velocity) (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) (t : ℝ) (x : Position) : Velocity := u t (x + t • c.ofLp) - c

galileanVelocity_initial.basis: Independent back-translation, then Tao v5 equation (1), notation, and Section 2 mean-zero reduction, with explicit moving-frame and norm calculations. See runs/review-2026-11-23-mean-zero.md.
galileanVelocity_initial.statement: theorem galileanVelocity_initial (c : Velocity) (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) : galileanVelocity c u 0 = fun x ↦ u 0 x - c

galileanVelocity_inverse.basis: Independent back-translation, then Tao v5 equation (1), notation, and Section 2 mean-zero reduction, with explicit moving-frame and norm calculations. See runs/review-2026-11-23-mean-zero.md.
galileanVelocity_inverse.statement: theorem galileanVelocity_inverse (c : Velocity) (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) : galileanVelocity (-c) (galileanVelocity c u) = u

globalRegularity.statement: def globalRegularity : Prop := ∀ u₀ : Position → Velocity, ContDiff ℝ ∞ u₀ → LatticePeriodic u₀ → (∀ x, spatialDivergence u₀ x = 0) → ∃ (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) (p : ℝ → Position → ℝ), SmoothSolution (Set.Ici 0) u₀ u p

h1Norm.basis: Independent Lean back-translation completed before consulting Tao v5, Section 1, equation (1), Notation, Conjectures 1.1–1.3, and Theorem 1.4, with Section 2 and 3.2 context for H¹. The restriction implication is infrastructure. See runs/review-2026-11-23-section-one-clean.md.
h1Norm.statement: noncomputable def h1Norm (v : Position → Velocity) : ℝ≥0 := let energy := ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ‖v x‖ ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖spatialPartial i v x‖ ^ 2 ⟨Real.sqrt energy, Real.sqrt_nonneg energy⟩

h1Norm_sq_galilean_centered.basis: Independent back-translation, then Tao v5 equation (1), notation, and Section 2 mean-zero reduction, with explicit moving-frame and norm calculations. See runs/review-2026-11-23-mean-zero.md.
h1Norm_sq_galilean_centered.statement: theorem h1Norm_sq_galilean_centered (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) (t : ℝ) (hSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t)) (hPeriodic : LatticePeriodic (u t)) : (h1Norm (u t) : ℝ) ^ 2 = (h1Norm (galileanVelocity (spatialMean (u t)) u t) : ℝ) ^ 2 + ‖spatialMean (u t)‖ ^ 2

integral_periodic_divergence_eq_zero.basis: Compared the coordinate divergence and cover periodicity with the unit torus setup and the integration by parts used in Sections 2 and 3.2. See runs/review-2026-11-23-PeriodicCalculus.md.
integral_periodic_divergence_eq_zero.statement: theorem integral_periodic_divergence_eq_zero (f : Fin 3 → Position → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i)) (hper : ∀ i, LatticePeriodic (f i)) : (∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ∑ i, spatialPartial i (f i) x) = 0

kineticEnergy_hasDerivWithinAt.basis: Compared both intermediate statements with the Section 3.2 energy calculation and equation (1). See runs/review-2026-11-23-Energy-components.md.
kineticEnergy_hasDerivWithinAt.statement: theorem kineticEnergy_hasDerivWithinAt {T : ℝ} {u : ℝ → Position → Velocity} (hT : 0 < T) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Position ↦ u z.1 z.2) (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ‖u s x‖ ^ 2) (∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, 2 * ⟪u t x, derivWithin (fun s ↦ u s x) (Set.Icc 0 T) t⟫_ℝ) (Set.Icc 0 T) t

kineticEnergy_identity.basis: Compared the statement and SmoothSolution with equation (1) and the energy identity in Section 3.2, including normalization, endpoint derivatives, and the spatial mean. See runs/review-2026-11-23-Energy.md.
kineticEnergy_identity.statement: theorem kineticEnergy_identity {T : ℝ} {u₀ : Position → Velocity} {u : ℝ → Position → Velocity} {p : ℝ → Position → ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hu : SmoothSolution (Set.Icc 0 T) u₀ u p) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ‖u s x‖ ^ 2) (-2 * ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖spatialPartial i (u t) x‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 T) t

kineticEnergy_spatialBalance.basis: Compared both intermediate statements with the Section 3.2 energy calculation and equation (1). See runs/review-2026-11-23-Energy-components.md.
kineticEnergy_spatialBalance.statement: theorem kineticEnergy_spatialBalance (v : Position → Velocity) (q : Position → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hvper : LatticePeriodic v) (hqper : LatticePeriodic q) (hdiv : ∀ x, spatialDivergence v x = 0) : (∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, 2 * ⟪v x, spatialLaplacian v x - pressureGradient q x - fderiv ℝ v x (v x).ofLp⟫_ℝ) = -2 * ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : Position) 1, ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖spatialPartial i v x‖ ^ 2

latticePeriodic_factors_torus.statement: theorem latticePeriodic_factors_torus {E : Type*} (f : Position → E) (hPeriodic : LatticePeriodic f) : ∃ F : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3) → E, ∀ x, F (torusPoint x) = f x

longTermBound.statement: def longTermBound : Prop := ∃ F : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0, Monotone F ∧ ∀ (T : ℝ), 0 < T → ∀ (u₀ : Position → Velocity) (u : ℝ → Position → Velocity) (p : ℝ → Position → ℝ), SmoothSolution (Set.Icc 0 T) u₀ u p → h1Norm (u T) ≤ F (h1Norm u₀)

spatialMean_conserved.statement: theorem spatialMean_conserved {times : Set ℝ} (hConvex : Convex ℝ times) (hZero : 0 ∈ times) (hDiff : UniqueDiffOn ℝ times) {u₀ : Position → Velocity} {u : ℝ → Position → Velocity} {p : ℝ → Position → ℝ} (h : SmoothSolution times u₀ u p) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ times) : spatialMean (u t) = spatialMean u₀
